Momcozy Wellness 1 Wearable Breast Pump with Warmth and Massage
📦 Dispatch: Pre-orders will be dispatched in the order they were placed, starting from 8 October .
Being 'well' postpartum is not just about physical wellness. It's about feeling comfortable, calm, and creating a sense of ease throughout the breastfeeding journey.
The Wellness 1 does all of the above. It brings together warm massage and a baby-like sucking rhythm, helping the body to relax and encouraging a more natural milk flow.
Featuring an industry-first* combination of all-over warmth and vibration massage in a wearable design, the Wellness 1 helps to ease physical tension and encourage the body's natural let-down response – for pumping that feels effortless and more comfortable.
*Based on available market data as of November 2025.
Soothing Warmth. Gentle Massage.
All-over warmth and synchronised vibration massage create a more relaxed pumping experience and optimal milk flow.
Five-zone vibration massage moves in sync with suction, delivering a more coordinated and fluid pumping rhythm.
Micro-pulse suction mimics the baby's feeding patterns for a softer, more natural feel.
Heated DoubleFit™ Comfort Flange
All-over warmth (37°C / 39°C / 41°C) and a soft, secure fit provide lasting comfort while pumping.
A transparent top allows easy visibility, while one-press dismantle makes setup and cleaning refreshingly simple.
Smart Features for Effortless Pumping
Up to 10 sessions of battery life and app connectivity keep pumping flexible, connected and easy to manage.
Flange accessories are not microwave-safe. Do not sterilize them in a microwave.
Do NOT use this device if you have a cardiac pacemaker, implanted defibrillator, or any other metallic or electronic implant, as it may cause electromagnetic interference or serious injury.

Why Warmth and Massage Make a Difference
Associated with Higher Milk Volumes
"WHO notes that higher milk volumes have been associated with warming the breast before pumping, as well as with massage and relaxation techniques."
Expert： – Katie Clark, International Board-Certified Lactation Consultant
The Difference Is All-Over Warmth
360° heating gently warms the entire contact area, helping the breast to relax for an optimal and more natural start to milk flow.
In real user testing, nearly 70% reported earlier let down when using warmth and massage in Stimulation Mode – optimising comfort and overall pumping experience.
*Based on quantitative findings from internal real-user testing. Results are self-reported. Individual results may vary.
Expert-Engineered Safety in Every Detail
Thermal safety requires a margin below the 43°C burn-risk threshold. To account for natural temperature fluctuations, Momcozy has capped the Wellness 1 at 41°C.
Expert-Guided Protection, Built In
Prolonged warmth may increase the risk of skin discomfort, so built-in time limits maintain a comfortable, controlled experience.
— Lactation Experts & Momcozy Medical Team
The Wellness 1 is CE-marked* and made with BPA-free milk-contact materials and upgraded, softer silicone. The result is greater

peace of mind, while delivering gentle comfort directly on the skin.

Every Detail, Thoughtfully Designed
Does the heat feature of the Wellness 1 help with pumping?
Gentle heat is commonly used during expressing because it can help breast tissue relax — similar to a warm compress — and may support a more comfortable let-down. The Momcozy Wellness 1 is a heated wearable breast pump that builds wraparound warmth and rhythmic massage into a hands-free breast pump, so you do not need a separate heat pack.
This combined approach is key:
1. The gentle heat helps your breast tissue relax, just like a warm compress.
2. The rhythmic massage uses soothing vibrations to mimic a baby’s natural touch. Warmth and massage are often used together because they may support oxytocin, the hormone involved in milk let-down.
How does the heating feature on the Momcozy Wellness 1 work, and is it a safe heated breast pump?
The Wellness 1 uses a wraparound warmth design that works like a built-in warm compress on the flange area. You can choose 3 temperature levels (37°C / 39°C / 41°C) . Warmth automatically stops after 15 minutes, and massage after 5 minutes.
This warming breast pump is designed to give wide, gentle heat that helps the breast relax during your session, with temperatures limited to these set levels.
What is the difference between the Momcozy Wellness 1 and the Air 1?
Both are wearable pumps with app control, but they are built for different needs. The Wellness 1 adds wraparound warmth and rhythmic vibration massage, so heat, massage and suction can work together. The Air 1 does not have heat or massage; it is the slimmer option and includes a charging case, which the Wellness 1 does not. Choose the Wellness 1 if you want a warm-massage pumping session; choose the Air 1 if a slim profile and charging case matter more.
How does the Momcozy Wellness 1 compare to a standard pump?
A standard pump typically uses suction alone, and many are not designed to be worn in the bra. The Wellness 1 is a wearable breast pump and a heated breast pump in one: it adds r hythmic massage and wraparound warmth to suction. That is why it is also described as a warming, hands-free breast pump — heat and massage are built in, rather than added with a separate compress or massager.
Has the Momcozy Wellness 1 been tested for safety and does it have certifications?
Yes, absolutely. We tested the motor and all parts of the Momcozy Wellness 1 very carefully. Experts checked them to make sure they are safe, strong and built to last. Rest assured that this breast pump complies with all relevant safety standards and certifications, making it a reliable companion for your entire feeding journey. If you have pain, inflammation or a breast infection, speak to your GP, midwife or health visitor, and do not use the warmth function unless they advise it is appropriate.
Does the pump come with accessories or spare parts?
Yes. The Wellness 1 includes the parts you need to start pumping, including 24 mm flanges and 17 mm, 19 mm and 21 mm inserts for fit. Spare parts such as valves and collection cups are available separately.
Does the Momcozy Wellness 1 require an app to work?
No. You can use it with or without the app . The built-in LED display lets you adjust settings on the pump. Connecting to the app adds phone control for suction, warmth and massage without reaching under your top, plus one-tap expert modes to help manage milk flow — including overnight ses

sions.
Does the Wellness 1 come with a charging case?
The Wellness 1 does not include a separate charging case, but its built-in battery is so powerful that it matches the performance of pumps that do include one .
It features a high-capacity 2200 mAh battery, which is much larger than many other wearable pumps. This design makes the Wellness 1 powerful yet simple to carry.
On a single full charge, the Wellness 1 provides industry-leading runtime:
Up to 10 sessions in Standard Mode – for reference, some pumps with charging cases offer around 15 sessions in total, making the Wellness 1’s 10-session standalone performance very impressive.
Up to 6 sessions in Warm-Massage Mode
This high-capacity design ensures you have enough power for both day and night use, without needing to carry a bulky extra charging case.
Is there a carry or travel bag included?
No, the Wellness 1 does not include a dedicated carry or travel bag.
Its compact design makes it easy to store in most personal bags, backpacks or baby bags.

I've been very happy with all my Momcozy products so far and this is not an exception. These are perfect any time you're busy and need to multitask, but they also do a great job as the primary pumps. They are relatively discreet, though not invisible and allow you to adjust the pumping speeds from your phone. If you've been pumping you know that there's no one speed that works in every situation, so adjusting based on size or situation is critical here. These are simple to charge and simple to pair with your phone. The pumping speed is pretty comparable to the larger Spectra pumps, which is very impressive. You're going to want to have replacement parts for the reservoir and valves so that you're always ready to pump while the other may be washing. Great value and quality.
